partners.name: Target Integration Ltd.
partners.about_text: Target Integration is a leading Odoo implementation partner in Ireland, specialising in ERP, CRM, digital transformation and automation. With three offices on the island of Ireland, Dublin, Cork, and Belfast, our team has helped many businesses across varied industries and market sectors to streamline their operations, increase productivity, and ultimately achieve their business goals. Our dedication lies in comprehending the pain points and distinct challenges faced by our clients. This enables us to deliver the most optimal solution, empowering business owners and directors to concentrate on running their enterprises and achieving their goals. Target Integration’s solutions are tailored to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and optimise Odoo’s full potential. Our team of experts provides exceptional service, ensuring clients receive the guidance and support they need before, during, and after the implementation process. We believe our success is directly influenced by and linked to our clients' success. We are committed to building long-term relationships and partnerships. Our quality management and information security standards are underpinned by ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certification. In addition to our certifications, TI holds memberships with esteemed Irish affiliations such as the Small Firms Association (SFA) and the Irish Manufacturing Research (IMR). We work with organisations such as Local Enterprise Office (LEO) and Enterprise Ireland (EI) to help companies implement Odoo. Our wide range of Odoo services includes: Full implementation of Odoo, including customisation and integration. Data migration from your legacy software to Odoo, ensuring the preservation of historical data. Ongoing support and maintenance to ensure your systems run smoothly and minimise business interruption. Training and education for your staff to help them get the most out of Odoo. Successful businesses across multiple industries trust Target Integration, including those working in manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, and operations. With over 10 years of experience and proven expertise in Odoo implementation, we have helped clients automate their manual processes and integrate disparate systems to streamline procedures and benefit both businesses as usual, as well as provide insights and reporting. partners.name: Valeordo
partners.about_text: Your Trusted Odoo Partner for Business Transformation Maximise Your Business Potential with Valeordo : Where Operational Excellence Meets Financial Precision. Engaging with Valeordo means more than just a software upgrade. Our clients gain the unique advantage of a partner with deep-rooted expertise in both complex business operations and the accounting function. We specialise in transitioning businesses from restricted environments like Sage 50, QuickBooks, and Xero —as well as other traditional legacy packages—into Odoo’s high-performance, integrated ecosystem. We ensure your entire business speaks the same language as your finance team. What You Gain When You Partner with Valeordo When you choose Valeordo to manage your transition from Sage, QuickBooks, or Xero, your business secures three core pillars of value: 1. Guaranteed Financial Integrity & Deep Accounting Insight Transitioning accounts is a high-stakes task. With Valeordo, you gain a team that understands the nuances of Irish and UK accounting standards. Audit-Ready Migration: Move from legacy platforms with total confidence. We guarantee the accuracy of your opening balances, aged creditors, and debtors. Compliance by Design: Your system will be configured from day one to handle VAT, RCT, and Revenue reporting with zero friction. Real-Time Visibility: Gain the ability to see your true financial position at any moment, moving away from the "delayed reporting" cycles of traditional software. 2. Seamless Operational Integration Entry-level accounting software is often an island. Valeordo bridges the gap between your back office and your front-line operations. End-to-End Synergy: We synchronise your Warehouse, Manufacturing, and Sales workflows directly with your nominal ledger. Elimination of Silos: Gain a "single source of truth." No more manual data entry between your operations and your Xero or Sage data—with Odoo, they become one. Process Optimisation: We don't just digitise your current mess; we refine your workflows to save time and reduce overheads. 3. Local Expertise & Hands-On Partnership We provide a level of accessibility that global implementers cannot match. Direct Access to Experts: You gain a dedicated project team that understands the Irish and UK business landscape. Reduced Risk: Our proven methodology for migrating from traditional accounting packages ensures a "Go Live" with minimal disruption to your daily trade. Staff Empowerment: Your team gains the skills they need through bespoke training, moving them from being "software users" to "process owners." The Valeordo Guarantee: Deep Knowledge, Delivered. We pride ourselves on our dual-competency. Whether it's a complex manufacturing bill of materials or a sophisticated multi-currency consolidation, our deep knowledge of the accounting function and operational logic is guaranteed. Stop outgrowing your software. Start scaling your business with Valeordo. partners.name: Combined Media Company
partners.about_text: Combined Media, a Dublin-based digital agency, now offers comprehensive Odoo services to streamline business operations and drive growth. Their end-to-end solutions include: Consultation & Strategy : Assessing business processes to identify efficiency enhancements through Odoo. Implementation & Customisation : Configuring and tailoring Odoo to align with specific workflows and objectives. Integration Services : Seamlessly connecting Odoo with existing tools, platforms, and third-party applications. Training & Support : Providing expert training and ongoing assistance to ensure effective utilization of Odoo. Upgrades & Maintenance : Keeping systems updated with the latest Odoo features and enhancements. With years of expertise in digital transformation, Combined Media delivers scalable, user-friendly, and cost-effective solutions to help businesses maximize the potential of Odoo. Odoo ERP Modules Offered by Combined Media Combined Media provides a range of Odoo applications to cover every aspect of your business: Sales CRM : Manages leads, opportunities, and customer interactions, integrating advanced features for sales planning, email integration, and meeting organization. Sales Management : Handles the entire sales cycle from quotations and sales orders to delivery and invoicing, integrating seamlessly with inventory, accounting, and shipping. Inventory Inventory Management : Monitors stock movements, inventory levels, and warehouse activities, offering features like automated purchase orders, accurate stock control, and real-time inventory visibility. Human Resources HR Management : Oversees employee records, recruitment, payroll, expenses, leave management, appraisals, and timesheets, ensuring efficient human resource operations. Project Management Project Management : Provides tools for planning and tracking tasks, timesheets, issues, and projects, including scheduling using Gantt charts and configurable billing rates to streamline business processes. Manufacturing Manufacturing : Enables production planning, bill of materials management, work orders, and capacity scheduling, covering the full production cycle from product design to output. Website and E-commerce Website Builder : Allows the creation of responsive websites and e-commerce stores without coding, using a drag-and-drop editor and templating. E-commerce : Integrates with inventory, sales, and accounting modules to provide a seamless online shopping experience for customers. Marketing Marketing Automation : Offers email marketing, automated campaigns, events management, surveys, and social media integration to enhance marketing efforts. Point of Sale POS : Provides a touchscreen point-of-sale interface for physical stores and restaurants, handling cashier operations, payments, orders, and real-time inventory updates.
